equity.equity_measurement: Comparisons are by WHO region, World Bank country income group and Gavi eligibility (geography, not SPDs); no within-country SPD breakdowns.

notes: Design not named; monitoring inferred from IA2030 progress framing. Estimates are WUENIC values; the report tabulates and contrasts them by year, region and income group. IA2030 targets are stated but no result is explicitly compared against them, so the referent is 2019 coverage.
view_issues: Summary gives MCV1 as 81% to 84%, but text and Table 2 give 83%. Methods footnote defines low-income as GNI <$13,845, contradicting Table 1 note (≤$1,135).
